title: REA: reverse engineer anything with your AI agent
notes: Facts checked 2026-10-10: github.com/morluto/rea (README: REA, Reverse Engineer Anything; MIT; one MCP server for reverse engineering binaries, applications and runtime behavior; inspects apps without source code, explains, shows evidence, builds a version; setup `npx rea-agents setup` supports Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Grok Build; native analysis via Hopper, Ghidra or IDA (pseudocode, assembly, strings, symbols, calls, references); JavaScript/Electron (modules, imports, source maps, routes, IPC); websites; .NET; Android APKs; firmware; results include code, references and unknowns; analysis runs locally, the agent's model provider has its own data policy; showcases: DX-Ball sound-pan reconstruction passes 3,205 original-x86 cases and reproduces all 63 compiled function bytes; Notion clipboard traced through preload and IPC into the main process). GitHub trending (daily) on 2026-10-10: 25,784 stars today, 62,043 total. Narration: Chatterbox (MIT) on the laptop's CPU. Also: the same tools work from the terminal; setup makes backups of existing agent configuration.

lines.text: You see a feature in someone else's app, and you think: how did they build that?
say: You see a feature in someone else's app, and you think:
how did they build that?

lines.text: REA lets your AI agent find out, without the source code.
say: R E A lets your AI agent find out, without the source code.

lines.text: It picked up 25,000 GitHub stars in a single day.
say: It picked up twenty-five thousand GitHub stars in a single day.

lines.text: REA is a free, open-source MCP server. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Gemini call it like a toolbox. The same tools work straight from your terminal, too.
say: R E A is a free, open-source M C P server.
Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Gemini call it like a toolbox.
The same tools work straight from your terminal, too.

lines.text: Point it at a native program, and it pulls out the assembly, pseudocode, strings and symbols, with Ghidra, Hopper or IDA doing the heavy lifting.
say: Point it at a native program, and it pulls out the assembly, pseudocode, strings and symbols,
with Ghidra, Hopper or I D A doing the heavy lifting.

lines.text: An Electron or JavaScript app? It maps the modules, the imports, and the messages passed between processes.
say: An Electron or JavaScript app?
It maps the modules, the imports, and the messages passed between processes.

lines.text: It also reads websites, .NET assemblies, Android APKs, even firmware.
say: It also reads websites, dot net assemblies, Android A P Ks, even firmware.

lines.text: Every answer comes with its evidence: the code it found, and what it still doesn't know.
say: Every answer comes with its evidence:
the code it found, and what it still doesn't know.

lines.text: Then your agent can explain the feature, or build a version of it for your own project.
say: Then your agent can explain the feature, or build a version of it for your own project.

lines.text: One real case: the classic game DX-Ball. It followed a sound into the code that pans it left and right.
say: One real case: the classic game D X Ball.
It followed a sound into the code that pans it left and right.

lines.text: The rebuilt C code passes 3,205 tests against the original, and compiles to the same 63 bytes.
say: The rebuilt C code passes three thousand two hundred and five tests against the original,
and compiles to the same sixty-three bytes.

lines.text: Another traces how Notion's clipboard works, from the window, through the bridge, into the main process.
say: Another traces how Notion's clipboard works, from the window, through the bridge, into the main process.

lines.text: Setup is a single npx command that backs up your agent's config first, and the analysis runs on your own machine.
say: Setup is a single N P X command that backs up your agent's config first, and the analysis runs on your own machine.

lines.text: The catch: deep native analysis needs Ghidra, Hopper or IDA installed. And your AI provider still sees the results.
say: The catch: deep native analysis needs Ghidra, Hopper or I D A installed.
And your AI provider still sees the results.

lines.text: So only take apart software you're allowed to.
say: So only take apart software you're allowed to.

lines.text: That's today's tool. There's a new one every day.
say: That's today's tool.
There's a new one every day.
